_metadata.name: IPTables Rule Modification for Traffic Signaling
_metadata.description: Attacker manipulates iptables to redirect traffic from a legitimate port to a backdoor listener using PREROUTING NAT rules. After establishing the channel, evidence is deleted by removing the redirect rule.
